label: A shaking in the natural is what brings the shaking in the spiritual
description: Stated as a rule rather than an event: what happens in the natural is going to happen in the spiritual, so earthquakes on the ring of fire over Asia are the mechanism that brings the major revival there. Useful because it can be checked across several events rather than one.
aliases: A shaking in the natural, a shaking in the spiritual
Watch the ring of fire
I've not forgotten my Asian people

label: The iron curtain lifts over North Korea for a short window
description: The iron curtain comes down in North Korea for a short window in which the country is flooded and many are born again, and then it does not stay down for very long. The short window framing means even a brief and unverifiable opening could be claimed.
aliases: I'm bringing down the Iron Curtain
a short window to reach the people
will not stay down for very long

label: A major move of God inside the Catholic Church
description: A major move of God among the 1.4 billion in the Catholic Church, with the pope seen trying to bring in a younger generation as the grey-haired go home, a South Korean flag alongside, and prayer asked for Rome and Italy. He notes his wife told him the pope had already called for youth revival, so the news came first.
aliases: a major move of God in the Catholic Church
the pope says he wants revival with the youth
1.4 billion people

label: A meeting he saw in the spirit and is forbidden to describe
description: He says he was present in the spirit at a meeting with North Korea and Cuba in the shadows and a plan the Americans did not know about, that the Lord told him he cannot say what was in it, and that a third world war is rice paper thin away with Australia involved. A sixth recorded withholding.
aliases: I can't say what was in the meeting
I was in the meeting in the spirit
rice paper thin

label: Earthquakes bigger than any on record, in several places at once
description: Earthquakes greater than anything ever recorded and well beyond ordinary tremors, in multiple places at the same time, because the earth's crust is shifting from an outside source. The instrumental record tops out at the 1960 Chile magnitude 9.5, which gives this a hard benchmark to beat.
aliases: earthquakes bigger than we've ever seen before
The earth's crust is shifting
from an outside source

label: Angel armies on the California shore stopped the tsunami
description: He says angel armies stood on the western seashore of California in answer to the live stream prayer and were sent on to Hawaii, and that this is why the tsunami from the 29 July 2025 Kamchatka earthquake did no major damage in California, Hawaii, Alaska or Japan. The waves were forecast as small on the American coast before the prayer.
aliases: angel armies
send them down to Hawaii
we didn't have any major damage

label: Mount Fuji explodes with the force of an atomic blast
description: Mount Fuji explodes suddenly while civilians go about an ordinary day, the snow cap completely levelled, at a scale he compares to a major atomic blast, and Japan's economy crumbles because of it. Fuji last erupted in 1707 and is continuously monitored; naming the volcano is the strongest form this claim could take.
aliases: I saw Mount Fuji explode
the equivalent of major atomic blast
The snow cap was completely decimated

label: The coastline from British Columbia to Alaska on fire
description: The whole coastline from British Columbia up to Alaska on fire from natural gas or something coming up out of the ground, seen alongside a mile wide volcano off the Oregon coast and Japan divided in two. He says he does not understand the fire and does not want to add to what he saw.
aliases: all of the coastline of Alaska on fire
natural gas or something coming up
the whole coastline was on fire

label: A major drought and a very hot Australian summer
description: A major drought and a very hot summer warned for Australia, inside a standing pattern of extreme drought in one place and flooding rain in another that he attributes to weather manipulation. Drought in one region and flooding in another is the normal state of the Australian continent, which makes the paired form untestable.
aliases: major drought and very hot summer for Australia
so dry and so drought in one place
weather manipulation

label: Markets shaken, with Japan and the Japanese economy named
description: Markets will be shaken, repeated three times in the flow of a prayer session, with Japan and the economy of Japan named specifically.
aliases: Markets will be shaken
a great shaking Japan
the economy of Japan

label: Modi votes against Israel and a shaking comes to India
description: A man with a grey beard seen voting against Israel on war crimes, identified by his son as Modi, with a great shaking coming to India and the temples falling to dust with monkeys on them. India abstained rather than voting against Israel on the major 2025 UN resolutions, and the identification was made by his son from memory rather than given in the vision.
aliases: the man with the gray beard
That's the man, Modi
War crimes. Voting against standing against Israel

label: Revival popping unpredictably like popcorn, beyond anyone's control
description: The coming revival breaks out in many places at once like popcorn in a hot pan, and cannot be controlled or organised the way Brownsville and other revivals were after a while. The unpredictability is built in, which removes any place where its absence could be checked.
aliases: you don't know which one's going to pop next
popped all over the place
you're not going to control it

label: Multiple volcanoes erupting simultaneously and quakes past 9.0
description: Not one volcano but multiple all at the same time, with earthquakes greater than 9.0 in several places at once, the rock affecting the tides, the sun's light changed and animals migrating and breeding wrongly. Only five magnitude 9 earthquakes have been instrumentally recorded in a century, so simultaneity would be unmistakable.
aliases: it will be multiple all at the same time
more than like 9.0
confusion in the camp for nature

label: Water events in Venice that have never happened before
description: The water in Venice acting strangely with flooding and rising tides, water events that have never happened before, given alongside a volcano about to go off near Rome. Venice floods most winters and the MOSE barriers were built for it, so only a record event would count.
aliases: Watch Venice, Italy
Water events are about to take place
a rise of the tides

label: Golden anchor chains from Missouri into the sky
description: Three or four massive golden ship anchor chains extending from Missouri straight up into the sky, pulled tight with no slack, glowing transparent gold and sparkling, running from Tulsa over to Branson and up by Kansas City. He says he does not know what it is. The triangle is where he lives and where the churches he names are.
aliases: golden chains
they're pulled tight
This is an area that's anchored in you

label: The war and the Epstein news are a sleight of hand
description: The Ukraine war, the tariff threats and the Epstein list are a distraction on one hand while a one world government and a digital platform for the beast system are built with the other, a warning he dates to a 17 June prayer. He names no specific measure, so any later legislation could be fitted to it.
aliases: The slight of hand is going on with this hand
a great missed opportunity
he warned us about this on June 17th
